Binding company standard. The rules below are the summary; the linked file is authoritative. Read only the section the task needs.

## Open-source documentation strategy

Documentation follows implementation in the same change and lives in the
repository. The README is a landing page and map (*Progressive Disclosure*).
Text meets *Plain Language (ISO 24495)*; procedures use *ASD-STE100* rules.
Examples are executable promises. Docs deploy locally to `gh-pages` without
GitHub Actions. Status and limits are honest; a release needs the minimum
release documentation gate.

## AI-agent accessibility and generative discovery

Every public product offers three AI access paths over one released truth: a
canonical AI-readable Markdown product guide, public generative-discovery
files, and a read-only MCP resource server. Documentation stays usable
without MCP; MCP tools exist only for real product functionality; mutating
tools need explicit authorization design. AI-facing surfaces are versioned
and verified with the release.
